title: c-RCP Zone Manifest
description: Schema for the zone registry manifest loaded by rcp_config_load() (rcp/config.h)

priority.description: Default command priority for this zone (currently informational only -- rcp_config_load() does not yet act on this field, matching cpp-RCP's own config.hpp)

transport.description: Transport adapter to instantiate for this zone (currently informational only -- rcp_config_load() always registers a mock controller regardless of this field, matching cpp-RCP's own load(), which likewise ignores it entirely). Limited to the transports shipped as of this milestone (v0.29.0); does not include protocol bridges landing in later milestones.
